job.title: Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
About the role:
1. Answer customer questions about our cloud storage product by email and live chat, in English.
2. Troubleshoot account, billing and sync problems; escalate bugs to engineering with clear reproduction steps.
3. Write and update help centre articles.
4. Meet service targets: first reply within 2 hours by email, satisfaction above 90%.

Requirements:
1. 2+ years in customer support for a software product.
2. Excellent written English.
3. Comfortable with basic troubleshooting: browsers, operating systems, networking basics.
4. Able to work a rotating shift that includes some weekends.
5. Experience with a ticketing system is a plus.
